description: This file implements the MasqueEncapsulatedClient class and related components for handling QUIC encapsulated client sessions with MASQUE mode support, including custom packet writing and network helper classes.

classes.name: ChecksumWriter
classes.description: Helper class for computing checksums over packet data.

classes.name: MasquePacketWriter
classes.description: Custom packet writer that encapsulates packet creation and sending logic, including IPv4/IPv6 header construction.

classes.name: MasqueClientDefaultNetworkHelper
classes.description: Network helper class that injects the custom MasquePacketWriter for outgoing packets.

methods.name: ChecksumWriter::IngestUInt16
methods.description: Adds a 16-bit value to the checksum accumulator.

methods.name: ChecksumWriter::IngestUInt8
methods.description: Adds an 8-bit value to the checksum accumulator, considering byte order.

methods.name: ChecksumWriter::IngestData
methods.description: Reads data from the writer and updates checksum.

methods.name: ChecksumWriter::WriteChecksumAtOffset
methods.description: Finalizes checksum and writes it at specified offset.

methods.name: MasquePacketWriter::WritePacket
methods.description: Constructs and sends a QUIC packet encapsulated in IPv4 or IPv6 headers, including checksum calculations.

methods.name: MasquePacketWriter::IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Indicates if the writer is blocked.

methods.name: MasquePacketWriter::MessageTooBigErrorCode
methods.description: Returns error code if message is too big.

methods.name: MasquePacketWriter::IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates if batch mode is supported.

methods.name: MasqueClientDefaultNetworkHelper::CreateQuicPacketWriter
methods.description: Creates and returns a custom MasquePacketWriter instance.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClient::MasqueEncapsulatedClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encapsulated client with server info, event loop, proof verifier, and masque client.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClient::CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession for the connection.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClient::masque_encapsulated_client_session
methods.description: Returns the current encapsulated client session.
